note: Input to scripts/acceptance.mjs. Each set mutates one committed .mmd fixture and then asks the snap pass for the new positions. `expectWarnings` is the exact list of warnings the run must produce, spelled `code(id,...)` from each warning's own `{code, ids, message}` — sorted, and with multiplicity: two `unresolvable-anchor` warnings are two entries, and a set whose warning moves to another node fails the gate as loudly as one that grows or loses a warning.

sets.title: Room auth flow + metrics leaf
sets.what: Adds a leaf node and places it with one `rel` directive.

sets.title: Room auth flow + MFA branch
sets.what: Adds a three-node branch; the second and third directives chain off a node this same pass is placing, and the third one lands on the `queue` node's box and is resolved to the nearest free cell (D19).

sets.title: Deploy pipeline + a hostile directive set
sets.what: The deliberately bad set (D7, D8): a directive for an id the chart has no node for, an absurd coordinate a million px into the gutter, and two `rel` directives anchored on each other. None of it may move a frozen node, and all of it has to be reported.
sets.shiftWhy: Pre-existing, and only the viewport-relative check sees it: the snap pass clamps a movable node's bare box to x >= MARGIN, landing `stray` at exactly x=20, while the renderer's content bounds include its 2px stroke (x=19). The viewBox origin therefore extends to -1 and the whole picture moves 1px right on screen at 0px store drift — the D18 complaint in miniature. The fix is in src/ (clamp against the stroked box, or bound the render origin by the bare one) and is the owner's call, so the exact shift is pinned here instead of tolerated.

sets.title: Room auth flow − the leftmost node
sets.what: Deletes `reject`, the leftmost node in the fixture (x=140, 230px left of the next one) — the exact case D18 names. The content bounds shrink, every remaining node is frozen and no directive is given, so a renderer that derived its origin from the content would shift the whole picture on screen at 0px *store* drift. The gate measures the drift viewport-relative, so it sees that.
